fixes.was: Article II requires that the President be able to remove at will principal officers who exercise executive power, so the for-cause removal protection of FTC Commissioners is unconstitutional and Humphrey's Executor is overruled to the extent it permitted otherwise.
fixes.now: Article II requires that the President be able to remove at will the Commissioners of the FTC, principal officers exercising executive power, so their for-cause protection is unconstitutional and Humphrey's Executor is overruled to the extent it permitted otherwise; the Federal Reserve and other entities were reserved.
